description: This file defines the 'Filter' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the Core Report Filter namespace. It implements the FilterDefinition interface and provides methods to normalize filter data and retrieve metadata. The class appears to serve as a base or placeholder for filter-related functionality in the reporting module.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents a filter within the reporting module, implementing the FilterDefinition interface with methods for normalization and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an array representing the normalized filter data. Currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns an instance of ParameterBag containing metadata, or null if none exists. Currently returns null.
